subject: [hw] V20 rev 2 addendum: arm64-ios compile check now passes (no code change)
body:
Correction to the not-done list in DONE V20 rev 2: this tree does have an iPhoneOS SDK (gpu/build/apple-toolchain/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk, thanks to hw-iv/V41 for pointing it out). Both V20 sources now pass a compile check for the real target:

    SDK=gpu/build/apple-toolchain/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk
    clang -target arm64-apple-ios16.0 -isysroot $SDK -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
          -I gpu/hwcodec/include -c emu/n2a32_neon_misc.c -o /tmp/n2hw-V20/misc_ios.o
    clang ... emu/n2a32_neon_ldst.c -o /tmp/n2hw-V20/ldst_ios.o
    -> zero warnings, Mach-O 64-bit arm64 objects

No source change; run_tests.sh is still N2TEST V20 PASS 436882/436882 and the k20 differential is now 1120/1120 after T01s V14 patch. STATUS files updated (compile check moved from "not done" to evidence). R1: no need to re-review the code for this; it is only an extra compile target on the same sources.
